posts.title: Revocation Is a Latency Requirement
posts.summary: The useful question is not whether authorization may be cached. It is how long a removed relationship, disabled account, or emergency restriction may still authorize an operation—and whether the full path can prove that bound.

posts.title: A Page Cursor Is Not Permission to Keep Reading
posts.summary: Treat a page cursor as continuation state, not an access grant. Bind it to the query shape, reject incompatible reuse, and apply fresh authorization before every page.
